gates.name: reference-agreement:moments_vs_scipy
gates.detail: 6/6 agree [skewness=-0.22661 vs ref -0.22661; kurtosis=0.16429 vs ref 0.16429; max_diff_scipy=4.4409e-16 vs ref 0; approx_gaussian=1 vs ref 1; mean=0.24188 vs ref 0.24188; sd=48.833 vs ref 48.833]
gates.citation: Joanes DN, Gill CA (1998). Comparing measures of sample skewness and kurtosis. The Statistician 47:183-189. Reference impl: scipy.stats.skew / kurtosis (Fisher, biased) + numpy.mean/std (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: eegmmidb, PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Joanes DN, Gill CA (1998). Comparing measures of sample skewness and kurtosis. The Statistician 47:183-189. Reference impl: scipy.stats.skew / kurtosis (Fisher, biased) + numpy.mean/std (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: eegmmidb, PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the amplitude-distribution moments with scipy.stats.skew / kurtosis and numpy on the identical signal; reports skewness, excess kurtosis, the max deviation from scipy, whether the distribution is approximately Gaussian, and the mean and (population) SD
